requirements.title: IEEE_GET_UNDERFLOW_MODE description defines the operation
requirements.definition: IEEE_GET_UNDERFLOW_MODE gets the current underflow mode.

pending.IEEE_GET_UNDERFLOW_MODE-operation-descri: Probe IEEE_SUPPORT_UNDERFLOW_CONTROL(0.0); supported branch calls IEEE_GET_UNDERFLOW_MODE to save ORIG, calls IEEE_SET_UNDERFLOW_MODE(.NOT. ORIG), calls IEEE_GET_UNDERFLOW_MODE and asserts the changed value equals .NOT. ORIG, restores ORIG with IEEE_SET_UNDERFLOW_MODE, then calls IEEE_GET_UNDERFLOW_MODE and asserts the restored value equals ORIG; unsupported branch records skip.

Unsupported branch records skip.
